My want of desires has made me averse to wealth and the gross pleasures it yields, which are as tints of clouds tainting the (clear disk of the) moon.

sanskrit: saptadaśaḥ sargaḥ śrīrāma uvāca / hārdāndhakāraśarvaryā tṛṣṇayeha durantayā / sphuranti cetanākāśe doṣakauśikapaṅkatayaḥ //
english: I see our vices like a flock of owls flying about in the region of our minds, under the darkness of our affections, and in the longsome night of our avarice.

sanskrit: antardāhapradāyinyā samūḍharasamārdavaḥ / paṅka ādityadīptyeva śoṣaṃ nīto'smi cintayā //
english: I am parched by my anxieties like the wet clay under solar rays, infusing an inward heat in it by extraction of its soft moisture.

sanskrit: mama cittamahāraṇyevyāmohatimirākule / śūnye tāṇḍavinī jātā bhṛśamāśāpiśācikā //
english: My mind is like a vast and lonesome wilderness, covered under the mist of errors, and infested by the terrible fiend of desire is continually floundering about it.

sanskrit: vacoracitanīhārā kāñcanopavanojjvalā / nūnaṃ vikāsamāyāti cintācaṇakamañjarī //
english: My wailings and tears serve only to expand and mature my anxiety, as the dews of night open and ripen the blossoms of beans and give them a bright golden hue.

sanskrit: alamantarbhramāyaiva tṛṣṇātaralitāśayā / āyātā viṣamollāsamūrmirambunidhāviva //
english: Avarice by raising expectations in men, serves only to whirl them about, as the vortex of the sea wallows the marine animals in it.

sanskrit: agnim īl̥e puraḥ hitam yajñasya devam r̥tvijam hotāram ratna dhātamam
english: I Laud Agni, the chosen Priest, God, minister of sacrifice, The hotar, lavishest of wealth.

sanskrit: agniḥ pūrvebhiḥ r̥ṣi bhiḥ īḍyaḥ nūtanaiḥ uta saḥ devān ā iha vakṣati
english: Worthy is Agni to be praised by living as by ancient seers. He shall bring hitherward the Gods.

sanskrit: agninā rayim aśnavat poṣam eva dive dive yaśasam vīravat tamam
english: Through Agni man obtaineth wealth, yea, plenty waxing day by day, Most rich in heroes, glorious.

sanskrit: agne yam yajñam adhvaram viśvataḥ pari bhūḥ asi saḥ it deveṣu gacchati
english: Agni, the perfect sacrifice which thou encompassest about Verily goeth to the Gods.

sanskrit: agniḥ hotā kavi kratuḥ satyaḥ citraśravaḥ tamaḥ devaḥ devebhiḥ ā gamat
english: May Agni, sapient-minded Priest, truthful, most gloriously great, The God, come hither with the Gods.

sanskrit: yat aṅga dāśuṣe tvam agne bhadram kariṣyasi tava it tat satyam aṅgiraḥ
english: Whatever blessing, Agni, thou wilt grant unto thy worshipper, That, Angiras, is indeed thy truth.

sanskrit: upa tvā agne dive dive doṣāvastaḥ dhiyā vayam namaḥ bharantaḥ ā imasi
english: To thee, dispeller of the night, O Agni, day by day with prayer Bringing thee reverence, we come

sanskrit: rājantam adhvarāṇām gopām r̥tasya dīdivim vardhamānam sve dame
english: Ruler of sacrifices, guard of Law eternal, radiant One, Increasing in thine own abode.

sanskrit: saḥ naḥ pitāiva sūnave agne su upāyanaḥ bhava sacasva naḥ svastaye
english: Be to us easy of approach, even as a father to his son: Agni, be with us for our weal.

sanskrit: vāyo iti ā yāhi darśata ime somāḥ araṁ kr̥tāḥ teṣām pāhi śrudhi havam
english: BEAUTIFUL Vâyu, come, for thee these Soma drops have been prepared: Drink of them, hearken to our call.

sanskrit: vāyo iti ukthebhiḥ jarante tvām accha jaritāraḥ suta somāḥ ahaḥ vidaḥ
english: Knowing the days, with Soma juice poured forth, the singers glorify Thee, Vâyu, with their hymns of praise.

sanskrit: vāyo iti tava pra pr̥ñcatī dhenā jigāti dāśuṣe urūcī soma pītaye
english: Vâyu, thy penetrating stream goes forth unto the worshipper, Far-spreading for the Soma draught.

sanskrit: indravāyūiti ime sutāḥ upa prayaḥ bhiḥ ā gatam indavaḥ vām uśanti hi
english: These, Indra-Vâyu, have been shed; come for our offered dainties' sake: The drops are yearning for you both.

sanskrit: vāyo iti indraḥ ca cetathaḥ sutānām vājinīvasūitivājinī vasū tau ā yātam upa dravat
english: Well do ye mark libations, ye Vâyu and Indra, rich in spoil So come ye swiftly hitherward.

sanskrit: vāyo iti indraḥ ca sunvataḥ ā yātam upa niḥ kr̥tam makṣu itthā dhiyā narā
english: Vâyu and Indra, come to what the Soma. presser hath prepared: Soon, Heroes, thus I make my prayer.

sanskrit: mitram huve pūta dakṣam varuṇam ca riśādasam dhiyam ghr̥tācīm sādhantā
english: Mitra, of holy strength, I call, and foe-destroying Varuṇa, Who make the oil-fed rite complete.

sanskrit: r̥tena mitrāvaruṇau r̥tāvr̥dhau r̥ta spr̥śā kratum br̥hantam āśātheiti
english: Mitra and Varuṇa, through Law, lovers and cherishers of Law, Have ye obtained your might power

sanskrit: kavī iti naḥ mitrāvaruṇā tuvi jātau uru kṣayā dakṣam dadhāteiti apasam
english: Our Sages, Mitra-Varuṇa, wide dominion, strong by birth, Vouchsafe us strength that worketh well.

sanskrit: aśvinā yajvarīḥ iṣaḥ dravatpāṇī itidravat pāṇī śubhaḥ patī iti puru bhujā canasyatam
english: YE Aṣvins, rich in treasure, Lords of splendour, having nimble hands, Accept the sacrificial food.

sanskrit: aśvinā puru daṁsasā narā śavīrayā dhiyā dhiṣṇyā vanatam giraḥ
english: Ye Aṣvins, rich in wondrous deeds, ye heroes worthy of our praise, Accept our songs with mighty thought.

sanskrit: dasrā yuvākavaḥ sutāḥ nāsatyā vr̥kta barhiṣaḥ ā yātam rudravartanī itirudra vartanī
english: Nisatyas, wonder-workers, yours arc these libations with clipt grass: Come ye whose paths are red with flame.

sanskrit: indra ā yāhi citrabhāno iticitra bhāno sutāḥ ime tvāyavaḥ aṇvībhiḥ tanā pūtāsaḥ
english: O Indra marvellously bright, come, these libations long for thee, Thus by fine fingers purified.

sanskrit: indra ā yāhi dhiyā iṣitaḥ vipra jūtaḥ suta vataḥ upa brahmāṇi vāghataḥ
english: Urged by the holy singer, sped by song, come, Indra, to the prayers, Of the libation-pouring priest.

sanskrit: indra ā yāhi tūtujānaḥ upa brahmāṇi hari vaḥ sute dadhiṣva naḥ canaḥ
english: Approach, O Indra, hasting thee, Lord of Bay Horses, to the prayers. In our libation take delight.

sanskrit: omāsaḥ carṣaṇi dhr̥taḥ viśve devāsaḥ ā gata dāśvāṁsaḥ dāśuṣaḥ sutam
english: Ye Viṣvedevas, who protect, reward, and cherish men, approach Your worshipper's drink-offering.

sanskrit: viśve devāsaḥ ap turaḥ sutam ā ganta tūrṇayaḥ usrāḥ iva svasarāṇi
english: Ye Viṣvedevas, swift at work, come hither quickly to the draught, As milch-kine hasten to their stalls.

sanskrit: viśve devāsaḥ asridhaḥ ehi māyāsaḥ adruhaḥ medham juṣanta vahnayaḥ
english: The Viṣvedevas, changing shape like serpents, fearless, void of guile, Bearers, accept the sacred draught

sanskrit: pāvakā naḥ sarasvatī vājebhiḥ vājinī vatī yajñam vaṣṭu dhiyāvasuḥ
english: Wealthy in spoil, enriched with hymns, may bright Sarsavad desire, With eager love, our sacrifice.

sanskrit: codayitrī sūnr̥tānām cetantī su matīnām yajñam dadhe sarasvatī
english: Inciter of all pleasant songs, inspirer o all gracious thought, Sarasvatî accept our rite

sanskrit: mahaḥ arṇaḥ sarasvatī pra cetayati ketunā dhiyaḥ viśvāḥ vi rājati
english: Sarasvatî, the mighty flood,– she with be light illuminates, She brightens every pious thought.

sanskrit: surūpa kr̥tnum ūtaye sudughām iva go duhe juhūmasi dyavi dyavi
english: As a good cow to him who milks, we call the doer of fair deeds, To our assistance day by day.

sanskrit: upa naḥ savanā ā gahi somasya soma pāḥ piba go dāḥ it revataḥ madaḥ
english: Come thou to our libations, drink of Soma; Soma-drinker thou! The rich One's rapture giveth kine.

sanskrit: atha te antamānām vidyāma su matīnām mā naḥ ati khyaḥ ā gahi
english: So may we be acquainted with thine innermost benevolence: Neglect us not, come hitherward.

sanskrit: parā ihi vigram astr̥tam indram pr̥ccha vipaḥ citam yaḥ te sakhi bhyaḥ ā varam
english: Go to the wise unconquered One, ask thou of Indra, skilled in song, Him who is better than thy friends.

sanskrit: uta bruvantu naḥ nidaḥ niḥ anyataḥ cit ārata dadhānāḥ indre it duvaḥ
english: Whether the men who mock us say, Depart unto another place, Ye who serve Indra and none else;

sanskrit: uta naḥ subhagān ariḥ voceyuḥ dasma kr̥ṣṭayaḥ syāma it indrasya śarmaṇi
english: Or whether, God of wondrous deeds, all our true people call us blest, Still may we dwell in Indra's care.

sanskrit: ā īm āśum āśave bhara yajña śriyam nr̥ mādanam patayat mandayat sakham
english: Unto the swift One bring the swift, man-cheering, grace of sacrifice, That to the Friend gives wings and joy.

sanskrit: asya pītvā śatakrato itiśata krato ghanaḥ vr̥trāṇām abhavaḥ pra āvaḥ vājeṣu vājinam
english: Thou, Ṣatakratu, drankest this and wast the Vr̥itras' slayer; thou Helpest the warrior in the fray.

sanskrit: tam tvā vājeṣu vājinam vājayāmaḥ śatakrato itiśata krato dhanānām indra sātaye
english: We strengthen, Ṣatakratu, thee, yea, thee the powerful in fight, That, Indra, we may win us wealth.

sanskrit: yaḥ rāyaḥ avaniḥ mahān su pāraḥ sunvataḥ sakhā tasmai indrāya gāyata
english: To him the mighty stream of wealth, prompt friend ot'him who pours the juice, yea, to this Indra sing your song.

sanskrit: ā tu ā ita ni sīdata indram abhi pra gāyata sakhāyaḥ stoma vāhasaḥ
english: O COME ye hither, sit ye down: to Indra sing ye forth, your song, companions, bringing hymns of praise.

sanskrit: puru tamam purūṇām īśānam vāryāṇam indram some sacā sute
english: To him the richest of the rich, the Lord of treasures excellent, Indra, wi th Soma juice outpoured.

sanskrit: saḥ gha naḥ yoge ā bhuvat saḥ rāye saḥ puram dhyām gamat vājebhiḥ ā saḥ naḥ
english: May he stand by us in our need and in abundance for our wealth: May he come nigh us with his strength.

sanskrit: yasya sam sthe na vr̥ṇvate harī iti samat su śatravaḥ tasmai indrāya gāyata
english: Whose pair of tawny horses yoked in battles foemen challenge not: To him, to Indra sing your song.

sanskrit: suta pāvne sutāḥ ime śucayaḥ yanti vītaye somāsaḥ dadhi āśiraḥ
english: Nigh to the Soma-drinker come, for his enjoyment, these pure drops, The Somas mingled with the curd.

sanskrit: tvam sutasya pītaye sadyaḥ vr̥ddhaḥ ajāyathāḥ indra jyaiṣṭhyāya sukrato itisu krato
english: Thou, grown at once to perfect strength, wast born to drink the Soma juice, Strong Indra, for preeminence.

sanskrit: ā tvā viśantu āśavaḥ somāsaḥ indra girvaṇaḥ śam te santu pra cetase
english: O Indra, lover of the song, may these quick Somas enter thee: May they bring bliss to thee the Sage.

sanskrit: tvām stomāḥ avīvr̥dhan tvām ukthā śatakrato itiśata krato tvām vardhantu naḥ giraḥ
english: Our chants of praise have strengthened thee, O Ṣatakratu, and our lauds So strengthen thee the songs we sing.

sanskrit: akṣita ūtiḥ sanet imam vājam indraḥ sahasriṇam yasmin viśvāni paiṁsyā
english: Indra, whose succour never fails, accept these viands thousandfold, Wherein all manly powers abide.

sanskrit: mā naḥ martāḥ abhi druhan tanūnām indra girvaṇaḥ īśānaḥ yavaya vadham
english: O Indra, thou who lovest song, let no man hurt our bodies, keep Slaughter far from us, for thou canst.

sanskrit: yuñjanti bradhnam aruṣam carantam pari tasthuṣaḥ rocante rocanā divi
english: They who stand round him as he moves harness the bright, the ruddy Steed The lights are shining in the sky.

sanskrit: yuñjanti asya kāmyā harī iti vipakṣasā rathe śoṇā dhr̥ṣṇū iti nr̥ vāhasā
english: On both sides to the car they yoke the two bay coursers dear to him, Bold, tawny, bearers of the Chief.

sanskrit: ketum kr̥ṇvan aketave peśaḥ maryāḥ apeśase sam uṣat bhiḥ ajāyathāḥ
english: Thou, making light where no light was, and form, O men: where form was not, Wast born together with the Dawns.

sanskrit: āt aha svadhām anu punaḥ garbha tvam āīrire dadhānāḥ nāma yajñiyam
english: Thereafter they, as is their wont, threw off the state of' babes unborn, Assuming sacrificial names.

sanskrit: vīl̥u cit ārujatnu bhiḥ guhā cit indra vahni bhiḥ avindaḥ usriyāḥ anu
english: Thou, Indra, with the Tempest-Gods, the breakers down of what is firm ' Foundest the kine even in the cave.

sanskrit: deva yantaḥ yathā matim accha vidat vasum giraḥ mahām anūṣata śrutam
english: Worshipping even as they list, singers laud him who findeth wealth, The far-renowned, the mighty One.

sanskrit: indreṇa sam hi dr̥kṣase sam jagmānaḥ abibhyuṣā mandū iti samāna varcasā
english: Mayest thou verily be seen coming by fearless Indra's side: Both joyous, equal in your sheen.

sanskrit: anavadyaiḥ abhidyu bhiḥ makhaḥ sahasvat arcati gaṇaiḥ indrasya kāmyaiḥ
english: With Indra's well beloved hosts, the blameless, hastening to heaven, The sacrificer cries aloud.

sanskrit: ataḥ parijman ā gahi divaḥ vā rocanāt adhi sam asmin r̥ñjate giraḥ
english: Come from this place, O Wanderer, or downward from the light of heaven: Our songs of praise all yearn for this.

sanskrit: itaḥ vā sātim īmahe diva vā pārthivāt adhi indram mahaḥ vā rajasaḥ
english: Indra we seek to give us help, from here, from heaven above the earth, Or from the spacious firmament.

sanskrit: indram it gāthinaḥ br̥hat indram arkebhiḥ arkiṇaḥ indram vāṇīḥ anūṣata
english: INDRA the singers with high praise, Indra reciters with their lauds, Indra the choirs have glorified.

sanskrit: indraḥ it haryoḥ sacā sam miślaḥ ā vacaḥ yujā indraḥ vajrī hiraṇyayaḥ
english: Indra hath ever close to him his two bay steeds and word-yoked car, Indra the golden, thunder-armed.

sanskrit: indraḥ dīrghāya cakṣase ā sūryam rohayat divi vi gobhiḥ adrim airayat
english: Indra hath raised the Sun on high in heaven, that he may see afar: He burst the mountain for the kine.

sanskrit: indraḥ vājeṣu naḥ ava sahasra pradhaneṣu ca ugraḥ ugrābhiḥ ūti bhiḥ
english: Help us, O Indra, in the frays, yea, frays, where thousand spoils are gained, With awful aids, O awful One.

sanskrit: indram vayam mahādhane indram arbhe havāmahe yujam vr̥treṣu vajriṇam
english: In mighty battle we invoke Indra, Indra in lesser fight, The Friend who bends his bolt at fiends.

sanskrit: saḥ naḥ vr̥ṣan amum carum satrādāvan apa vr̥dhi asmabhyam aprati skutaḥ
english: Unclose, our manly Hero, thou for ever bounteous, yonder cloud, For us, thou irresistible.

sanskrit: tuñje tuñje ye ut tare stomāḥ indrasya vajriṇaḥ na vindhe asya su stutim
english: Still higher, at each strain of mine, thunder-armed Indra's praises rise: I find no laud worthy of him.

sanskrit: vr̥ṣā yūthāiva vaṁsagaḥ kr̥ṣṭīḥ iyarti ojasā īśānaḥ aprati skutaḥ
english: Even as the bull drives on the herds, he drives the people with his might, The Ruler irresistible:

sanskrit: yaḥ ekaḥ carṣaṇīnām vasūnām irajyati indraḥ pañca kṣitīnām
english: Indra who rules with single sway men, riches, and the fivefold race Of those who dwell upon the earth.

sanskrit: indram vaḥ viśvataḥ pari havāmahe janebhyaḥ asmākam astu kevalaḥ
english: For your sake from each side we call Indra away from other men: Ours, and none others', may he be.

sanskrit: ā indra sānasim rayim sa jitvānam sadāsaham varṣiṣṭham ūtaye bhara
english: INDRA, bring wealth that gives delight, the victor's ever-conquering wealth, Most excellent, to be our aid;

sanskrit: ni yena muṣṭi hatyayā ni vr̥trā ruṇadhāmahai tvāūtāsaḥ ni arvatā
english: By means of which we may repel our foes in battle hand to hand, By thee assisted with the car.

sanskrit: indra tvāūtāsaḥ ā vayam vajram ghanā dadīmahi jayema sam yudhi spr̥dhaḥ
english: Aided by thee, the thunder-armed, Indra, may we lift up the bolt, And conquer all our foes in fight.

sanskrit: vayam śūrebhiḥ astr̥ bhiḥ indra tvayā yujā vayam sāsahyāmapr̥tanyataḥ
english: With thee, O India, for ally with missile-darting heroes, may We conquer our embattled foes.

sanskrit: mahān indraḥ paraḥ ca nu mahi tvam astu vajriṇe dyauḥ na prathinā śavaḥ
english: Mighty is Indra, yea supreme; greatness be his, the Thunderer: Wide as the heaven extends his power

sanskrit: sam ohe vā ye āśata naraḥ tokasya sanitau viprāsaḥ vā dhiyāyavaḥ
english: Which aideth those to win them sons, who come as heroes to the fight, Or singers loving holy thoughts.

sanskrit: yaḥ kukṣiḥ soma pātamaḥ samudraḥ iva pinvate urvīḥ āpaḥ na kākudaḥ
english: His belly, drinking deepest draughts of Soma, like an ocean swells, Like wide streams from the cope of heaven.

sanskrit: eva hi asya sūnr̥tā vi rapśī go matī mahī pakvā śākhā na dāśuṣe
english: So also is his excellence, great, vigorous, rich in cattle, like A ripe branch to the worshipper.

sanskrit: eva hi te vi bhūtayaḥ ūtayaḥ indra māvate sadyaḥ cit santi dāśuṣe
english: For verily thy mighty powers, Indra, are saving helps at once Unto a worshipper like me.

sanskrit: eva hi asya kāmyā stomaḥ uktham ca śaṁsyā indrāya soma pītaye
english: So are his lovely gifts; let lauds and praises be to Indra sung, That he may drink the Soma juice.

sanskrit: indra ā ihi matsi andhasaḥ viśvebhiḥ somaparva bhiḥ mahān abhiṣṭiḥ ojasā
english: COME, Indra, and delight thee with the juice at all the Soma feasts, Protector, mighty in thy strength.

sanskrit: ā īm enam sr̥jata sute mandim indrāya mandine cakrim viśvāni cakraye
english: To Indra pour ye forth thejuice, the active gladdening juice to him Ile gladdening, oinnific God.

sanskrit: matsva su śipra mandi bhiḥ stomebhiḥ viśva carṣaṇe sacā eṣu savaneṣu ā
english: O Lord of all men, fair of cheek, rejoice thee in the gladdening lauds, Present at these drink-offerings.

sanskrit: asr̥gram indra te giraḥ prati tvām ud ahāsata ajoṣāḥ vr̥ṣabham patim
english: Songs have outpoured themselves to thee, Indra, the strong, the guardian Lord, And raised themselves unsatisfied.

sanskrit: sam codaya citram arvāk rādhaḥ indra vareṇyam asat it te vi bhu pra bhu
english: Send to us bounty manifold, O Indra, worthy of' our wish, For power supreme is only thine.

sanskrit: asmān su tatra codaya indra rāye rabhasvataḥ tuvi dyumna yaśasvataḥ
english: O Indra, stimulate thereto us emulously fain for wealth, And glorious, O most splendid One.

sanskrit: sam go mat indra vāja vat asme iti pr̥thu śravaḥ br̥hat viśva āyuḥ dhehi akṣitam
english: Give, Indra, wide and lofty fame, wealthy in cattle and in strength, Lasting our life-time, failing not.

sanskrit: iti dhehi śravaḥ br̥hat dyumnam sahasra sātamam indra tāḥ rathiniḥ iṣaḥ
english: Grant us high fame, O Indra, grant riches bestowing thousands, those Fair fruits of earth borne home in wains.

sanskrit: vasoḥ indram vasu patim gīḥ bhiḥ gr̥ṇantaḥ r̥gmiyam homa gantāram ūtaye
english: Praising with songs the praise-worthy who cometh to our aid, we call Indra, the Treasure-Lord of wealth.

sanskrit: sute sute ni okase br̥hat br̥hate ā it ariḥ indrāya śūṣam arcati
english: To lofty Indra, dweller by each libation, the pious man Sings forth aloud a strengthening hymn.

sanskrit: gāyanti tvā gāyatriṇaḥ arcanti arkam arkiṇaḥ brahmāṇaḥ tvā śatakrato itiśata krato ut vaṁśam iva yemire
english: THE chanters hymn thee, they who say the word of praise magnify thee. The priests have raised thee up on high, O Ṣatakratu, like a pole.

sanskrit: yat sānoḥ sānum ā aruhat bhūri aspaṣṭa kartvam tat indraḥ artham cetati yūthena vr̥ṣṇiḥ ejati
english: As up he clomb from ridge to ridge and looked upon the toilsome task, Indra observes this wish of his, and the Rain hastens with his troop.

sanskrit: yukṣva hi keśinā harī iti vr̥ṣaṇā kakṣya prā atha naḥ indra soma pāḥ girām upa śrutim cara
english: Harness thy pair of strong bay steeds, long-maned, whose bodies fill the girths, And, Indra, Soma-drinker, come to listen to our songs of praise.

sanskrit: ā ihi stomān abhi svara abhi gr̥ṇīhi ā ruva brahma ca naḥ vaso iti sacā indra yajñam ca vardhaya
english: Come hither, answer thou the song, sing in approval, cry aloud. Good Indra, make our prayer succeed, and prosper this our sacrifice.

sanskrit: uktham indrāya śaṁsyam vardhanam puruniḥ sidhe śakraḥ yathā suteṣu naḥ raraṇat sakhyeṣu ca
english: To Indra must a laud be said, to strengthen him who freely gives, That Ṣakra may take pleasure in our friendship and drink-offerings.

sanskrit: tam it sakhi tve īmahe tam rāye tam su vīrye saḥ śakraḥ uta naḥ śakat indraḥ vasu dayamānaḥ
english: Him, him we seek for friendship, him for riches and heroic might. For Indra, he is Ṣakra, he shall aid us while he gives us wealth.

sanskrit: su vivr̥tam suniḥ ajam indra tvādātam it yaśaḥ gavām apa vrajam vr̥dhi kr̥ṇuṣva rādhaḥ adri vaḥ
english: Easy to turn and drive away, Indra, is spoil bestowed by thee. Unclose the stable of the kine, and give us wealth O Thunder-armed

sanskrit: nahi tvā rodasī iti ubhe iti r̥ghāyamāṇam invataḥ jeṣaḥ svaḥ vatīḥ apaḥ sam gāḥ asmabhyam dhūnuhi
english: The heaven and earth contain thee not, together, in thy wrathful mood. Win us the waters of the sky, and send us kine abundantly.

sanskrit: āśrut karṇa śrudhi havam nū cit dadhiṣva me giraḥ indra stomam imam mama kr̥ṣva yujaḥ cit antaram
english: Hear, thou whose ear is quick, my call; take to thee readily my songs O Indra, let this laud of mine come nearer even than thy friend.

sanskrit: vidma hi tvā vr̥ṣan tamam vājeṣu havana śrutam vr̥ṣan tamasya hūmahe ūtim sahasra sātamām
english: We know thee mightiest of all, in battles hearer of our cry. Of thee most mighty we invoke the aid that giveth thousandfold.

sanskrit: ā tu naḥ indra kauśika mandasānaḥ sutam piba navyam āyuḥ pra su tira kr̥dhi sahasra sām r̥ṣim
english: O Indra, Son of Kuṣika, drink our libation with delight. Prolong our life anew, and cause the seer to win a thousand gifts.

sanskrit: pari tvā girvaṇaḥ giraḥ imāḥ bhavantu viśvataḥ vr̥ddha āyum anu vr̥ddhayaḥ juṣṭāḥ bhavantu juṣṭayaḥ
english: Lover of song, may these our songs on every side encompass thee: Strengthening thee of lengthened life, may they be dear delights to thee.

sanskrit: indram viśvāḥ avīvr̥dhan samudra vyacasam giraḥ rathi tamam rathīnām vājānām sat patim patim
english: ALL sacred songs have magnified Indra expansive as the sea, The best of warriors borne on cars, the Lord, the very Lord of strength.

sanskrit: sakhye te indra vājinaḥ mā bhema śavasaḥ pate tvām abhi pra nonumaḥ jetāram aparājitam
english: Strong in thy friendship, Indra, Lord of power and might, we have no fear. We glorify with praises thee, the never-conquered conqueror.

sanskrit: pūrvīḥ indrasya rātayaḥ na vi dasyanti ūtayaḥ yadi vājasya go mataḥ stotr̥ bhyaḥ maṁhate magham
english: The gifts of Indra from of' old, his saving succours, never fail, When to the praise-singers he gives the boon of substance rich in kine.

sanskrit: purām bhinduḥ yuvā kaviḥ amita ojāḥ ajāyata indraḥ viśvasya kamarṇaḥ dhartā vajrī puru stutaḥ
english: Crusher of forts, the young, the wise, of strength unmeasured, was he born Sustainer of each sacred rite, Indra, the Thunderer, much-extolled.

sanskrit: tvam valasya go mataḥ apa avaḥ adri vaḥ bilam tvām devāḥ abibhyuṣaḥ tujyamānāsaḥ āviṣuḥ
english: Lord of the thunder, thou didst burst the cave of Vala rich in cows. The Gods came pressing to thy side, and free from terror aided thee,

sanskrit: tava aham śūra rāti bhiḥ prati āyam sindhum āvadan upa atiṣṭhanta girvaṇaḥ viduḥ te tasya kāravaḥ
english: I, Hero, through thy bounties am come to the flood addressing thee. Song-lover, here the singers stand and testify to thee thereof.

sanskrit: māyābhiḥ indra māyinam tvam śuṣṇam ava atiraḥ viduḥ te tasya medhirāḥ teṣām śravāṁsi ut tira
english: The wily Ṣushṇa, Indra! thou o'er-threwest with thy wondrous powers. The wise beheld this deed of thine: now go beyond their eulogies.

sanskrit: indram īśānam ojasā abhi stomāḥ anūṣata sahasram yasya rātayaḥ uta vā santi bhūyasīḥ
english: Our songs of praise have glorified Indra who ruleth by his might, Whose precious gifts in thousands come, yea, even more abundantly.

sanskrit: agnim dūtam vr̥ṇīmahe hotāram viśva vedasam asya yajñasya su kratum
english: WE choose Agni the messenger, the herald, master of all wealth, Well skilled in this our sacrifice.

sanskrit: agnim agnim havīma bhiḥ sadā havanta viśpatim havya vāham puru priyam
english: With callings ever they invoke Agni, Agni, Lord of the House, Oblation-bearer, much beloved.

sanskrit: agne devān iha ā vaha jajñānaḥ vr̥kta barhiṣe asi hotā naḥ īḍyaḥ
english: Bring the Gods hither, Agni, born for him who strews the sacred grass: Thou art our herald, meet for praise.

sanskrit: tān uśataḥ vi bodhaya yat agne yāsi dūtyam devaiḥ ā satsi barhiṣi
english: Wake up the willing Gods, since thou, Agni, performest embassage: Sit on the sacred grass with Gods.

sanskrit: ghr̥ta āhavana dīdi vaḥ prati sma riṣataḥ daha agne tvam rakṣasvinaḥ
english: O Agni, radiant One, to whom the holy oil is poured, bum up Our enemies whom fiends protect.

sanskrit: agninā agniḥ sam idhyate kaviḥ gr̥ha patiḥ yuvā havya vāṭ juhu āsyaḥ
english: By Agni Agni is inflamed, Lord of the House, wise, young, who bears The gift: the ladle is his mouth.

sanskrit: kavim agnim upa stuhi satya dharmāṇam adhvare devam amīva cātanam
english: Praise Agni in the sacrifice, the Sage whose ways are ever true, The God who driveth grief away.

sanskrit: yaḥ tvām agne haviḥ patiḥ dūtam deva saparyati tasya sma pra avitā bhava
english: God, Agni, be his strong defence who lord of sacrificial gifts, Worshippeth thee the messenger.

sanskrit: yaḥ agnim deva vītaye haviṣmān āvivāsati tasmai pāvaka mr̥l̥aya
english: Whoso with sacred gift would fain call Agni to the feast of Gods, O Purifier, favour him.

sanskrit: saḥ naḥ pāvaka dīdi vaḥ agne devān iha ā vaha upa yajñam haviḥ ca naḥ
english: Such, Agni, Purifier, bright, bring hither to our sacrifice, To our oblation bring the Gods.

sanskrit: saḥ naḥ stavānaḥ ā bhara gāyatreṇa navīyasā rayim vīra vatīm iṣam
english: So lauded by our newest song of praise bring opulence to us, And food, with heroes for our sons.

sanskrit: agne śukreṇa śociṣā viśvābhiḥ devahūti bhiḥ imam stomam juṣasva naḥ
english: O Agni, by effulgent flame, by all invokings of the Gods, Show pleasure in this laud of ours.

sanskrit: su samiddhaḥ naḥ ā vaha devān agne haviṣmate hotariti pāvaka yakṣi ca
english: AGNI, well-kindled, bring the Gods for him who offers holy gifts. Worship them, Purifier, Priest.

sanskrit: madhu mantam tanū napāt yajñam deveṣu naḥ kave adya kr̥ṇuhi vītaye
english: Son of Thyself, present, O Sage, our sacrifice to the Gods today. Sweet to the taste, that they may feast.

sanskrit: narāśaṁsam iha priyam asmin yajñe upa hvaye madhu jihvam haviḥ kr̥tam
english: Dear Narâṣansa, sweet of tongue, the giver of oblations, I Invoke to this our sacrifice.

sanskrit: agne sukha tame rathe devān il̥itaḥ ā vaha asi hotā manuḥ hitaḥ
english: Agni, on thy most easy car, glorified, hither bring the Gods: Manu appointed thee as Priest.

sanskrit: str̥ṇīta barhiḥ ānuṣak ghr̥ta pr̥ṣṭham manīṣiṇaḥ yatra amr̥tasya cakṣaṇam
english: Strew, O ye wise, the sacred grass that drips with oil, in order due, Where the Immortal is beheld.

sanskrit: vi śrayantām r̥ta vr̥dhaḥ dvāraḥ devīḥ asaścataḥ adya nūnam ca yaṣṭave
english: Thrown open be the Doors Divine, unfailing, that assist the rite, For sacrifice this day and now.

sanskrit: naktoṣāsā su peśasā asmin yajñe upa hvaye idam naḥ barhiḥ āsade
english: I call the lovely Night and Dawn to seat them on the holy grass At this our solemn sacrifice.

sanskrit: tā su jihvau upa hvaye hotārā daivyā kavī iti yajñam naḥ yakṣatām imam
english: The two Invokers I invite, the wise, divine and sweet of tongue, To celebrate this our sacrifice.

sanskrit: il̥ā sarasvatī mahī tisraḥ devīḥ mayaḥ bhuvaḥ barhiḥ sīdantu asridhaḥ
english: Iḷâ, Sarasvatî, Mahi, three Goddesses who bring delight, Be seated, peaceful, on the grass.

sanskrit: iha tvaṣṭāram agriyam viśva rūpam upa hvaye asmākam astu kevalaḥ
english: Tvashṭar I call, the earliest born, the wearer of all forms at will: May he be ours and curs alone.

sanskrit: ava sr̥ja vanaspate deva devebhyaḥ haviḥ pra dātuḥ astu cetanam
english: God, Sovran of the Wood, present this our oblation to the Gods, And let the giver be renowned.

sanskrit: svāhā yajñam kr̥ṇotana indrāya yajvanaḥ gr̥he tatra devān upa hvaye
english: With Svâhâ pay the sacrifice to Indra in the offerer's house: Thither I call the Deities.

sanskrit: ā ebhiḥ agne duvaḥ giraḥ viśvebhiḥ soma pītaye devebhiḥ yāhi yakṣi ca
english: To drink the Soma, Agni, come, to our service and our songs. With all these Gods; and worship them.

sanskrit: ā tvā kaṇvāḥ ahūṣata gr̥ṇanti vipra te dhiyaḥ devebhiḥ agne ā gahi
english: The Kaṇvas have invoked thee; they, O Singer, sing thee songs of praise Agni, come hither with the Gods;

sanskrit: indravāyū iti br̥haspatim mitrā agnim pūṣaṇam bhagam ādityān mārutam gaṇam
english: Indra, Vâyu, Br̥ihaspati, Mitra, Agni, Pûshan, Bhaga, Âdityas, and the Marut host.

sanskrit: pra vaḥ bhriyante indavaḥ matsarāḥ mādayiṣṇavaḥ drapsāḥ madhvaḥ camū sadaḥ
english: For you these juices are poured forth that gladden and exhilarate, The meath-drops resting in the cup.

sanskrit: īl̥ate tvām avasyavaḥ kaṇvāsaḥ vr̥kta barhiṣaḥ haviṣmantaḥ aram kr̥taḥ
english: The sons of Kaṇva fain for help adore thee, having strewn the grass, With offerings and all things prepared.

sanskrit: ghr̥ta pr̥ṣṭhāḥ manaḥ yujaḥ ye tvā vahanti vahnayaḥ ā devān soma pītaye
english: Let the swift steeds who carry thee, thought-yoked and dropping holy oil, Bring the Gods to the Soma draught.

sanskrit: tān yajatrān r̥ta vr̥dhaḥ agne patnī vataḥ kr̥dhi madhvaḥ su jihva pāyaya
english: Adored, the strengtheners of Law, unite them, Agni, with their Dames: Make them drink meath, O bright of tongue.

sanskrit: ye yajatrāḥ ye īḍyāḥ te te pibantu jihvayā madhoḥ agne vaṣaṭ kr̥ti
english: Let them, O Agni, who deserve worship and praise drink with thy tongue Tle meath in solemn sacrifice.

sanskrit: ākīm sūryasya rocanāt viśvān devān uṣaḥ budhaḥ vipraḥ hotā iha vakṣati
english: Away, from the Sun's realm of light, the wise invoking Priest shall bring All Gods awaking with the dawn.

sanskrit: viśvebhiḥ somyam madhu agne indreṇa vāyunā piba mitrasya dhāma bhiḥ
english: With all the Gods, with Indra, with Vâyu, and Mitra's splendours, drink, Agni, the pleasant Soma juice.

sanskrit: tvam hotā manuḥ hitaḥ agne yajñeṣu sīdasi saḥ imam naḥ adhvaram yaja
english: Ordained by Manu as our Priest, thou sittest, Agni, at each rite: Hallow thou this our sacrifice.

sanskrit: yukṣva hi aruṣīḥ rathe haritaḥ deva rohitaḥ tābhiḥ devān iha ā vaha
english: Harness the Red Mares to thy car, the Bays, O God, the flaming ones: With those bring hitherward the Gods.

sanskrit: indra somam piba r̥tunā ā tvā viśantu indavaḥ matsarāsaḥ tat okasaḥ
english: O INDRA drink the Soma juice with Rtu; let the cheering drops Sink deep within, which settle there.

sanskrit: marutaḥ pibata r̥tunā potrāt yajñam pūnītana yūyam hi stha su dānavaḥ
english: Drink from the Purifier's cup, Maruts, with Rtu; sanctify The rite, for ye give precious gifts.

sanskrit: abhi yajñam gr̥ṇīhi naḥ grāvaḥ neṣṭariti piba r̥tunā tvam hi ratna dhā asi
english: O Neshṭar, with thy Dame accept our sacrifice; with R̥itudrink, For thou art he who giveth wealth.

sanskrit: agne devān iha ā vaha sādaya yoniṣu triṣu pari bhūṣa piba r̥tunā
english: Bring the Gods, Agni; in the three appointed places set them down: Surround them, and with R̥itudrink.

sanskrit: brāhmaṇāt indra rādhasaḥ piba somam r̥tūn anu tava it hi sakhyam astr̥tam
english: Drink Soma after the Rtus, from the Brahmana's bounty: undissolved, O Indra, is thy friendship's bond.

sanskrit: yuvam dakṣam dhr̥ta vratā mitrāvaruṇā duḥ dabham r̥tunā yajñam āśātheiti
english: Mitra, Varuṇa, ye whose ways are firm – a Power that none deceives-, With R̥ituye have reached the rite.

sanskrit: draviṇaḥ dāḥ draviṇasaḥ grāva hastāsaḥ adhvare yajñeṣu devam īl̥ate
english: The Soma-pressers, fain for wealth, praise the Wealth-giver in the rite, In sacrifices praise the God.

sanskrit: draviṇaḥ dāḥ dadātu naḥ vasūni yāni śr̥ṇvire deveṣu tā vanāmahe
english: May the Wealth-giver grant to us riches that shall be far renowned. These things we gain, among the Gods.

sanskrit: draviṇaḥ dāḥ pipīṣati juhota pra ca tiṣṭhata neṣṭrāt r̥tu bhiḥ iṣyata
english: He with the R̥ita fain would drink, Wealth-giver, from the Neshṭar's bowl. Haste, give your offering, and depart.

sanskrit: yat tvā turīyam r̥tu bhiḥ draviṇaḥ daḥ yajāmahe adha sma naḥ dadiḥ bhava
english: As we this fourth time, Wealth-giver, honour thee with the Rtus, be A Giver bountiful to us.

sanskrit: aśvinā pibatam madhu dīdyagnī itidīdi agnī śuci vratā r̥tunā yajña vāhasā
english: Drink ye the meath, O Aṣvins bright with flames, whose acts are pure. who with Rtus accept the sacrifice.

sanskrit: gārhapatyena santya r̥tunā yajña nīḥ asi devān devayate yaja
english: With Rtu, through the house-fire, thou, kind Giver, guidest sacrifice: Worship the Gods for the pious man.

sanskrit: ā tvā vahantu harayaḥ vr̥ṣaṇam soma pītaye indra tvā sūra cakṣasaḥ
english: LET thy Bay Steeds bring thee, the Strong, hither to drink the Soma draught- Those, Indra, who are bright as suns.

sanskrit: imāḥ dhānāḥ ghr̥ta snuvaḥ harī iti iha upa vakṣataḥ indram sukha tame rathe
english: Here are the grains bedewed with oil: hither let the Bay Coursers bring Indra upon his easiest car.

sanskrit: indram prātaḥ havāmahe indram pra yati adhvare indram somasya pītaye
english: Indra at early morn we call, Indra in course of sacrifice, Indra to drink the Soma juice.

sanskrit: upa naḥ sutam ā gahi hari bhiḥ indra keśi bhiḥ sute hi tvā havāmahe
english: Come hither, with thy long-maned Steeds, O Indra, to- the draught we pour We call thee wher, the juice is shed.

sanskrit: saḥ imam naḥ stomam ā gahi upa idam savanam sutam gauraḥ na tr̥ṣitaḥ piba
english: Come thou to this our song of praise, to the libation poured for thee Drink of it like a stag athirst.

sanskrit: ime somāsaḥ indavaḥ sutāsaḥ adhi barhiṣi tān indra sahase piba
english: Here are the drops of Soma juice expressed on sacred grass: thereof Drink, Indra, to increase thy might.

sanskrit: ayam te stomaḥ agriyāḥ hr̥dii spr̥k astu śam tamaḥ atha somam sutam piba
english: Welcome to thee be this our hymn, reaching thy heart, most excellent: Then drink the Soma juice expressed.

sanskrit: viśvam it savanam sutam indraḥ madāya gacchati vr̥tra hā soma pītaye
english: To every draught of pressed-out juice Indra, the Vr̥itra-slayer, comes, To drink the Soma for delight.

sanskrit: saḥ imam naḥ kāmam ā pr̥ṇa gobhiḥ aśvaiḥ śatakrato itiśatakrato stavāma tvā su ādhyaḥ
english: Fulfil, O Ṣatakratu, all our wish with horses and with kine: With holy thoughts we sing thy praise.

sanskrit: indrāvaruṇayoḥ aham sam rājoḥ avaḥ ā vr̥ṇe tā naḥ mr̥l̥ātaḥ īdr̥śe
english: I CRAVE help from the Imperial Lords, from Indra-Varuṇa; may they Both favour one of us like me.

sanskrit: gantārāḥ hi sthaḥ avase havam viprasya māvataḥ dhartārācarṣaṇīnām
english: Guardians of men, ye ever come with ready succour at the call Of every singer such as I.

sanskrit: anukāmam tarpayethām indrāvaruṇā rāyaḥ ā tā vām nediṣṭham īmahe
english: Sate you, according to your wish, O Indra-Varuṇa, with wealth: Fain would we have you nearest us.

sanskrit: yuvāku hi śacīnām yuvāku su matīnām bhūyāma vājadāvnām
english: May we be sharers of the powers, sharers of the benevolence Of you who give strength bounteously.

sanskrit: indraḥ sahasra dāvnām varuṇaḥ śaṁsyānām kratuḥ bhavati ukthyaḥ
english: Indra and Varuṇa, among givers of thousands, meet for praise, Are Powers who merit highest laud.

sanskrit: tayoḥ it avasā vayam sanema ni ca dhīmahi syāt uta pra recanam
english: Through their protection may we gain great store of wealth, and heap it up Enough and still to spare, be ours.

sanskrit: indrāvaruṇā vām aham huve citrāya rādhase asmān su jigyuṣaḥ kr̥tam
english: O Indra-Varuṇa, on you for wealth in many a form I call: Still keep ye us victorious.

sanskrit: indrāvaruṇā nu nu vām siṣāsantīṣu dhīṣu ā asmabhyam śarma yacchatam
english: O Indra-Varuṇa, – through our songs that seek to win you to ourselves, Give us at once your sheltering help.

sanskrit: pra vām aśnotu su stutiḥ indrāvaruṇā yām huve yām r̥dhātheiti sadha stutim
english: O Indra-Varuṇa, to you may fair praise which I offer come, joint eulogy which ye dignify.

sanskrit: somānam svaraṇam kr̥ṇuhi brahmaṇaḥ pate kakṣīvantam yaḥ auśijaḥ
english: O BRAHMANAPSATI, make him who presses Soma glorious, Even Kakshîvân Auṣija.

sanskrit: yaḥ revān yaḥ amīva hā vasu vit puṣṭi vardhanaḥ saḥ naḥ sisaktu yaḥ turaḥ
english: The rich, the healer of disease, who giveth wealth, increaseth store, The prompt,– may he be with us still.

sanskrit: mā naḥ śaṁsaḥ araruṣaḥ dhūrtiḥ praṇak martyasya rakṣa naḥ brahmaṇaḥ pate
english: Let not the foeman's curse, let not a mortal's onslaught fall on us Preserve us, Brahmaṇaspati.

sanskrit: saḥ gha vīraḥ na riṣyati yam indraḥ brahmaṇaḥ patiḥ somaḥ hinoti martyam
english: Ne'er is the mortal hero harmed whom Indra, Brahmaṇaspati, And Soma graciously inspire.

sanskrit: tvam tam brahmaṇaḥ pate somaḥ indraḥ ca martyam dakṣiṇā pātu aṁhasaḥ
english: Do, thou, O Brahmaṇaspati, and Indra, Soma, Dakshina, Preserve that mortal from distress.

sanskrit: sadasaḥ patim adbhutam priyam indrasya kāmyam sanim medhām ayāsiṣam
english: To the Assembly's wondrous Lord, to Indra's lovely Friend who gives Wisdom, have I drawn near in prayer.

sanskrit: yasmāt r̥te na sidhyati yajñaḥ vipaḥ citaḥ cana saḥ dhīnām yogam invati
english: He without whom no sacrifice, e'en of the wise man, prospers; he Stirs up the series of thoughts.

sanskrit: āt r̥dhnoti haviḥ kr̥tim prāñcam kr̥ṇoti adhvaram hotrā deveṣu gacchati
english: He makes the oblation prosper, he promotes the course of sacrifice: Our voice of praise goes to the Gods.

sanskrit: narāśaṁsam sudhr̥ṣṭamam apaśyam saprathaḥ tamam divaḥ na sadma makhasam
english: I have seen Narâṣansa, him most resolute, most widely famed, As 'twere the Household Priest of heaven.

sanskrit: prati tyam cārum adhvaram go pīthāya pra hūyase marut bhiḥ agne ā gahi
english: To this fair sacrifice to drink the milky draught thou art invoked: O Agni, with the Maruts come.

sanskrit: nahi devaḥ na martyaḥ mahaḥ tava kratum paraḥ marut bhiḥ agne ā gahi
english: No mortal man, no God exceeds thy mental power, O Mighty one – O Agni, with the Maruts come

sanskrit: ye mahaḥ rajasaḥ viduḥ viśve devāsaḥ adruhaḥ marut bhiḥ agne ā gahi
english: All Gods devoid of guile, who know the mighty region of mid-air: O Agni, with those Maruts come.

sanskrit: ye ugrāḥ arkam ānr̥cuḥ anādhr̥ṣṭāsaḥ ojasā marut bhiḥ agne ā gahi
english: The terrible, who sing their song, not to be overcome by might: O Agni, with those Maruts come.

sanskrit: ye śubhrāḥ ghora varpasaḥ su kṣatrāsaḥ riśādasaḥ marut bhiḥ agne ā gahi
english: Brilliant, and awful in their form, mighty, devourers of their foes': O Agni, with those Maruts come.

sanskrit: ye nākasya adhi rocane divi devāsaḥ āsate marut bhiḥ agne ā gahi
english: Who sit as Deities in heaven, above the sky-vault's luminous sphere: O Agni, with those Maruts come.

sanskrit: ye īṅkhayanti parvatān tiraḥ samudram arṇavam marut bhiḥ agne ā gahi
english: Who scatter clouds about the sky, away over the billowy sea: O Agni, with those Maruts come.

sanskrit: ā ye tanvanti raśmi bhiḥ tiraḥ samudram ojasā marut bhiḥ agne ā gahi
english: Who with their bright beams spread them forth over the ocean in their might O Agni, with those Maruts come.

sanskrit: abhi tvā pūrva pītaye sr̥jāmi somyam madhu marut bhiḥ agne ā gahi
english: For thee, to be thine early draught, I pour the Soma-mingled meath: O Agni, with the Maruts come.

sanskrit: ayam devāya janmane stomaḥ viprebhiḥ āsayā akāri ratna dhātamaḥ
english: FOR the Celestial Race this song of praise which gives wealth lavishly Was made by singers with their lips.

sanskrit: ye indrāya vacaḥ yujā tatakṣuḥ manasā harī iti śamāībhiḥ yajñam āśata
english: They who for Indra, with their mind, formed horses harnessed by a word, Attained by works to sacrifice.

sanskrit: takṣan nāsatyābhyām pari jmānam su kham ratham takṣan dhenum sabaḥ dughām
english: They for the two Nâsatyas wrought a light car moving every way: They formed a nectar-yielding cow.

sanskrit: yuvānā pitarā punariti satya mantrāḥ r̥jū yavaḥ r̥bhavaḥ viṣṭī akrata
english: The R̥ibhus with effectual prayers, honest, with constant labour, made Their Sire and Mother young again.

sanskrit: sam vaḥ madāsaḥ agmata indreṇa ca marutvatā ādityebhiḥ ca rāja bhiḥ
english: Together came your gladdening drops with Indra by the Maruts girt, With the Âdityas, with the Kings.

sanskrit: uta tyam camasam navam tvaṣṭuḥ devasya niḥ kr̥tam akarta caturaḥ punariti
english: The sacrificial ladle, wrought newly by the God Tvashṭar's hand- Four ladles have ye made thereof.

sanskrit: te naḥ ratnāni dhattana triḥ ā sāptāni sunvate ekam ekam suśasti bhiḥ
english: Vouchsafe us wealth, to him who pours thrice seven libations, yea, to each Give wealth, pleased with our eulogies.

sanskrit: adhārayanta vahnayaḥ abhajanta su kr̥tyayā bhāgam deveṣu yajñiyam
english: As ministering Priests they held, by pious acts they won themselves, A share in sacrifice with Gods.

sanskrit: iha indrāgnī iti upa hvaye tayoḥ it stomam uśmasi tā somam soma pātamā
english: INDRA and Agni I invoke fain are we for their song of praise Chief Soma-drinkers are they both.

sanskrit: tā yajñeṣu pra śaṁsata indrāgnī iti śumbhata naraḥ tā gāyatreṣu gāyata
english: Praise ye, O men, and glorify Indra-Agni in the holy rites: Sing praise to them in sacred songs.

sanskrit: tā mitrasya pra śastaye indrāgnī iti tā havāmahe soma pā soma pītaye
english: Indra and Agni we invite, the Soma-drinkers, for the fame Of Mitra, to the Soma-draught.

sanskrit: ugrā santā havāmahe upa idam savanam sutam indrāgnī iti ā iha gacchatām
english: Strong Gods, we bid them come to this libation that stands ready here: Indra and Agni, come to us.

sanskrit: tā mahāntā sadaspatī iti indrāgnī iti rakṣaḥ ubjatam aprajāḥ santu atriṇaḥ
english: Indra and Agni, mighty Lords of our assembly, crush the fiends: Childless be the devouring ones.

sanskrit: tena satyena jāgr̥tam adhi pra cetune pade indrāgnī iti śarma yacchatam
english: Watch ye, through this your truthfulness, there in the place of spacious view Indra and Agni, send us bliss.

sanskrit: prātaḥ yujā vi bodhaya aśvinau ā iha gacchatām asya somasya pītaye
english: WAKEN the Aṣvin Pair who yoke their car at early morn: may they Approach to drink this Soma juice.

sanskrit: yā su rathā rathi tamā ubhā devā divi spr̥śā aśvinā tā havāmahe
english: We call the Aṣvins Twain, the Gods borne in a noble car, the best Of charioteers, who reach the heavens.

sanskrit: yā vām kaśā madhu matī aśvinā sūnr̥tāvatī tayā yajñam mimikṣatam
english: Dropping with honey is your whip, Aṣvins, and full of pleasantness Sprinkle therewith the sacrifice.

sanskrit: nahi vām asti dūrake yatra rathena gacchathaḥ aśvinā sominaḥ gr̥ham
english: As ye go thither in your car, not far, O Aṣvins, is the home Of him who offers Soma juice.

sanskrit: hiraṇya pāṇim ūtaye savitāram upa hvaye saḥ cettā devatā padam
english: For my protection I invoke the golden-handed Savitar. He knoweth, as a God, the place.

sanskrit: apām napātam avase savitāram upa stuhi tasya vratāni uśmasi
english: That he may send us succour, praise the Waters' Offspring Savitar: Fain are we for his holy ways.

sanskrit: vi bhaktāram havāmahe vasoḥ citrasya rādhasaḥ savitāram nr̥ cakṣasam
english: We call on him, distributer of wondrous bounty and of wealth, On Savitar who looks on men.

sanskrit: sakhāyaḥ ā ni sīdata savitā stomyaḥ nu naḥ dātā rādhāṁsi śumbhati
english: Come hither, friends, and seat yourselves Savitar, to be praised by us, Giving good gifts, is beautiful.

sanskrit: agne patnīḥ iha ā vaha devānām uśatīḥ upa tvaṣṭāram soma pītaye
english: O Agni, hither bring to us the willing Spouses of the Gods, And Tvashṭar, to the Soma draught.

sanskrit: ā gnāḥ agne iha avase hotrām yaviṣṭha bhāratīm varūtrīm dhiṣaṇām vaha
english: Most youthful Agni, hither bring their Spouses, Hotrâ, Bhâratî, Varûtrî, Dhishaṇâ, for aid.

sanskrit: abhi naḥ devīḥ avasā mahaḥ śarmaṇā nr̥ patnīḥ acchinna patrāḥ sacantām
english: Spouses of Heroes, Goddesses, with whole wings may they come to us With great protection and with aid.

sanskrit: iha indrāṇīm upa hvaye varuṇānīm svastaye agnāyīm soma pītaye
english: Indrâṇî, Varuṇânî, and Agnayi hither I invite, For weal, to drink the Soma juice.

sanskrit: mahī dyauḥ pr̥thivī ca naḥ imam yajñam mimikṣatām pipr̥tām naḥ bharīma bhiḥ
english: May Heaven and Earth, the Mighty Pair, bedew for us our sacrifice, And feed us full with nourishments.

sanskrit: tayoḥ it ghr̥ta vat payaḥ viprāḥ rihanti dhīti bhiḥ gandharvasya dhruve pade
english: Their water rich with fatness, there in the Gandharva's steadfast place, The singers taste through sacred songs.

sanskrit: syonā pr̥thivi bhava anr̥kṣarā ni veśanī yaccha naḥ śarma sa prathaḥ
english: Thornless be thou, O Earth, spread wide before us for a dwelling-place: Vouchsafe us shelter broad and sure.

sanskrit: ataḥ devāḥ avantu naḥ yataḥ viṣṇuḥ vi cakrame pr̥thivyāḥ sapta dhāma bhiḥ
english: The Gods be gracious unto us even from the place whence Vishṇu strode Through the seven regions of the earth!

sanskrit: idam viṣṇuḥ vi cakrame tredhā ni dadhe padam sam ūl̥ham asya pāṁsure
english: Through all this world strode Vishṇu; thrice his foot he planted, and the whole Was gathered in his footstep's dust.

sanskrit: trīṇi padā vi cakrame viṣṇuḥ gopāḥ adābhyaḥ ataḥ dharmāṇi dhārayan
english: Vishṇu, the Guardian, he whom none deceiveth, made three steps; thenceforth Establishing his high decrees.

sanskrit: viṣṇoḥ karmāṇi paśyata yataḥ vratāni paspaśe indrasya yujyaḥ sakhā
english: Look ye on Vishṇu's works, whereby the Friend of Indra, close-allied, Hath let his holy ways be seen.

sanskrit: tat viṣṇoḥ paramam padam sadā paśyanti sūrayaḥ divi iva cakṣuḥ ātatam
english: The princes evermore behold that loftiest place where Vishṇu is, Laid as it were an eye in heaven.

sanskrit: tat viprāsaḥ vipanyavaḥ jāgr̥ vāṁsaḥ sam indhate viṣṇoḥ yat paramam padam
english: This, Vishṇu's station most sublime, the singers, ever vigilant, Lovers of holy song, light up.

sanskrit: tīvrāḥ somāsaḥ ā gahi āśīḥ vantaḥ sutāḥ ime vāyo iti tān pra sthitān piba
english: STRONG are the Somas; come thou nigh; these juices have been mixt with milk: Drink, Vâyu, the presented draughts.

sanskrit: ubhā devā divi spr̥śā indravāyū iti havāmahe asya somasya pītaye
english: Both Deities who touch the heaven, Indra and Vâyu we invoke To drink of this our soma juice.

sanskrit: indravāyū iti manaḥ juvā viprāḥ havante ūtaye sahasra akṣā dhiyaḥ patī iti
english: The singers' for their aid, invoke Indra and Vâyu, swift as mind, The thousand-eyed, the Lords of thought.

sanskrit: mitram vayam havāmahe varuṇam soma pītaye jajñānā pūta dakṣasā
english: Mitra and Varuṇa, renowned as Gods of consecrated might, We call to drink the Soma juice.

sanskrit: r̥tena yau r̥ta vr̥dhau r̥tasya jyotiṣaḥ patī iti tā mitrāvaruṇā huve
english: Those who by Law uphold the Law, Lords of the shining light of Law, Mitra I call, and Varuṇa.

sanskrit: varuṇaḥ pra avitā bhuvat mitraḥ viśvābhiḥ ūti bhiḥ karatām naḥ su rādhasaḥ
english: Let Varuṇa be our chief defence, let Mitra guard us with all aids Both make us rich exceedingly.

sanskrit: marutvantam havāmahe indram ā soma pītaye sa jūḥ gaṇena tr̥mpatu
english: Indra, by Maruts girt, we call to drink the Soma juice: may he Sate him in union with his troop.

sanskrit: indra jyeṣṭhāḥ marut gaṇāḥ devāsaḥ pūṣa rātayaḥ viśve mama śruta havam
english: Gods, Marut hosts whom Indra leads, distributers of Pûshan's gifts, Hearken ye all unto my cry.

sanskrit: hata vr̥tram su dānava indreṇa sahasā yujā mā naḥ duḥ śaṁsaḥ īśata
english: With conquering Indra for ally, strike Vr̥itra down, ye bounteous Gods Let not the wicked master us.

sanskrit: vviśvān devān havāmahe marutaḥ soma pītaye ugrāḥ hi pr̥śni mātaraḥ
english: We call the Universal Gods, and Maruts to the Soma draught, For passing strong are Pr̥iṣni's Sons.

sanskrit: jayatām iva tanyatuḥ marutām eti dhr̥ṣṇu yā yat śubham yāthana naraḥ
english: Fierce comes the Maruts' thundering voice, like that of conquerors, when ye go Forward to victory, O Men.

sanskrit: haskārāt vi dyutaḥ pari ataḥ jātāḥ avantu naḥ marutaḥ mr̥l̥ayantu naḥ
english: Born of the laughing lightning. may the Maruts guard us everywhere May they be gracious unto Us.

sanskrit: ā pūṣan citra barhiṣam āghr̥ṇe dharuṇam divaḥ ā aja naṣṭam yathā paśum
english: Like some lost animal, drive to us, bright Pûshan, him who bears up heaven, Resting on many-coloured grass.

sanskrit: pūṣā rājānam āghr̥ṇiḥ apa gūl̥ham guhā hitam avindat citra barhiṣam
english: Pûshan the Bright has found the King, concealed and bidden in a cave, Who rests on grass of many hues.

sanskrit: uto iti saḥ mahyam indu bhiḥ ṣaṭ yuktān anu sesidhat gobhiḥ yavam na carkr̥ṣat
english: And may he. duly bring to me the six bound closely, through these drops, As one who ploughs with steers brings corn.

sanskrit: ambayaḥ yanti adhva bhiḥ jāmayaḥ adhvari yatām pr̥ñcatīḥ madhunā payaḥ
english: Along their paths the Mothers go, Sisters of priestly ministrants, Mingling their sweetness with the milk.

sanskrit: amūḥ yāḥ upa sūrye yābhiḥ vā sūryaḥ saha tāḥ naḥ hinvantu adhvaram
english: May Waters gathered near the Sun, and those wherewith the Sun is joined, Speed forth this sacrifice of ours.

sanskrit: apaḥ devīḥ upa hvaye yatra gāvaḥ pibanti naḥ sindhu bhyaḥ kartvam haviḥ
english: I call the Waters, Goddesses, wherein our cattle quench their thirst; Oblations to the Streams be given.

sanskrit: ap su antaḥ amr̥tam ap su bheṣajam apām uta pra śastaye devāḥ bhavata vājinaḥ
english: Amrit is in the Waters in the Waters there is healing balm Be swift, ye Gods, to give them praise.

sanskrit: ap su me somaḥ abravīt antaḥ viśvāni bheṣajā agnim ca viśva śambhuvam āpaḥ ca viśva bheṣajīḥ
english: Within the Waters-Soma thus hath told me-dwell all balms that heal, And Agni, he who blesseth all. The Waters hold all medicines.

sanskrit: āpaḥ pr̥ṇīta bheṣajam varūtham tanve mama jyok ca sūryam dr̥śe
english: O Waters, teem with medicine to keep my body safe from harm, So that I long may see the Sun.

sanskrit: idam āpaḥ pra vahata yat kim ca duritam mayi yat vā aham abhi dudroha yat vā śepe uta anr̥tam
english: Whatever sin is found in me, whatever evil I have wrought. If I have lied or falsely sworn, Waters, remove it far from me.

sanskrit: āpaḥ adya anu acāriṣam rasena sam agasmahi payasvān agne ā gahi tam mā sam sr̥ja varcasā
english: The Waters I this day have sought, and to their moisture have we come: O Agni, rich in milk, come thou, and with thy splendour cover me.

sanskrit: sam mā agne varcasā sr̥ja sam pra jayā sam āyuṣā vidyuḥ me asya devāḥ indraḥ vidyāt saha r̥ṣi bhiḥ
english: Fill me with splendour, Agni; give offspring and length of days; the Gods Shall know me even as I am, and Indra with the R̥ishis, know.

sanskrit: kasya nūnam katamasya amr̥tānām manāmahe cāru devasya nāma kaḥ naḥ mahyai aditaye punaḥ dāt pitaram ca dr̥śeyam mātaram ca
english: WHO now is he, what God among Immortals, of whose auspicious name we may bethink us? Who shall to mighty Aditi restore us, that I may see my Father and my Mother?

sanskrit: agneḥ vayam prathamasya amr̥tānām manāmahe cāru devasya nāma saḥ naḥ mahyai aditaye punaḥ dāt pitaram ca dr̥śeyam mātaram ca
english: Agni the God the first among the Immortals, – of his auspicious name let us bethink us. He shall to mighty Aditi restore us, that I may see my Father and my Mother.

sanskrit: abhi tvā deva savitaḥ īśānam vāryāṇām sadā avan bhāgam īmahe
english: To thee, O Savitar, the Lord of precious things, who helpest us Continually, for our share we come-

sanskrit: yaḥ cit hi te itthā bhagaḥ śaśamānaḥ purā nidaḥ adveṣaḥ hastayoḥ dadhe
english: Wealth, highly lauded ere reproach hath fallen on it, which is laid, Free from all hatred, in thy hands

sanskrit: bhaga bhaktasya te vayam ut aśema tava avasā mūrdhānam rāyaḥ ārabhe
english: Through thy protection may we come to even the height of affluence Which Bhaga hath dealt out to us.

sanskrit: nahi te kṣatram na sahaḥ na manyum vayaḥ cana amī iti patayantaḥ āpuḥ na imāḥ āpaḥ ani miṣam carantīḥ na ye vātasya pra minanti abhvam
english: Ne'er have those birds that fly through air attained to thy high dominion or thy might or spirit; Nor these the waters that flow on for ever, nor hills, abaters of the wind's wild fury.

sanskrit: abudhne rājā varuṇaḥ vanasya ūrdhvam stūpam dr̥te pūta dakṣaḥ nīcīnāḥ sthuḥ upari budhnaḥ eṣām asme iti antaḥ ni hitāḥ ketavaḥ syuritisyuḥ
english: Varuṇa, King, of hallowed might, sustaineth erect the Tree's stem in the baseless region. Its rays, whose root is high above, stream downward. Deep may they sink within us, and be hidden.

sanskrit: urum hi rājā varuṇaḥ cakāra sūryāya panthām anu etavai oṁ iti apade pādā prati dhātave akaḥ uta apa vaktā hr̥daya vidhaḥ cit
english: King Varuṇa hath made a spacious pathway, a pathway for the Sun wherein to travel. Where no way was he made him set his footstep, and warned afar whate'er afflicts the spirit.

sanskrit: śatam te rājan bhiṣajaḥ sahasram urvī gabhīrā su matiḥ te astu bādhasva dūre niḥ r̥tim parācaiḥ kr̥tam cit enaḥ pra mumugdhi asmat
english: A hundred balms are thine, O King, a thousand; deep and wide-reaching also be thy favours. Far from us, far away drive thou Destruction. Put from us e'en the sin we have committed.

sanskrit: amī iti ye r̥kṣāḥ ni hitāsaḥ uccā naktam dr̥daśre kuha cit divā īyuḥ adabdhāni varuṇasya vratāni vi cākaśat candramāḥ naktam eti
english: Whither by day depart the constellations that shine at night, set high in heaven above us? Varuṇa's holy laws remain unweakened, and through the night the Moon moves on in splendor

sanskrit: tat tvā yāmi brahmaṇā vandamānaḥ tat ā śāste yajamānaḥ haviḥ bhiḥ ahel̥amānaḥ varuṇa iha bodhi uru śaṁsa mā naḥ āyuḥ pra moṣīḥ
english: I ask this of thee with my prayer adoring; thy worshipper craves this with his oblation. Varuṇa, stay thou here and be not angry; steal not our life from us, O thou Wide-Ruler.

sanskrit: tat it naktam tat divā mahyam āhuḥ tat ayam ketaḥ hr̥daḥ ā vi caṣṭe śunaḥśepaḥ yam ahvat gr̥bhītaḥ saḥ asmān rājā varuṇaḥ mumoktu
english: Nightly and daily this one thing they tell me, this too the thought of mine own heart repeateth. May he to whom prayed fettered Ṣunaḥṣepa, may he the Sovran Varuṇa release us.

sanskrit: śunaḥśepaḥ hi ahvat gr̥bhītaḥ triṣu ādityam dru padeṣu baddhaḥ ava enam rājā varuṇaḥ sasr̥jyāt vidvān adabdhaḥ vi mumoktu pāsān
english: Bound to three pillars captured Ṣunaḥṣepa thus to the Âditya made his supplication. Him may the Sovran Varuṇa deliver, wise, ne'er deccived, loosen the bonds that bind him.

sanskrit: ava te hel̥aḥ varuṇa namaḥ bhiḥ ava yajñebhiḥ īmahe haviḥ bhiḥ kṣayan asmabhyam asura pracetaitipra cetaḥ rājan enāṁsi śiśrathaḥ kr̥tāni
english: With bending down, oblations, sacrifices, O Varuṇa, we deprecate thine anger: Wise Asura, thou King of wide dominion, loosen the bonds of sins by us committed.

sanskrit: ut ut tamam varuṇa pāśam asmat ava adhamam vi madhyayamam śrathaya atha vayam āditya vrate tava anāgasaḥ aditaye syāma
english: Loosen the bonds, O Varuṇa, that hold me, loosen the bonds above, between, and under. So in thy holy law may we made sinless belong to Aditi, O thou Âditya.

sanskrit: yat cit hi te viśaḥ yathā pra deva varuṇa vratam minīmasi dyavi dyavi
english: WHATEVER law of thine, O God, O Varuṇa, as we are men, Day after day we violate.

sanskrit: mā naḥ vadhāya hatnave jihīl̥ānasya rīradhaḥ mā hr̥ṇānasyamanyave
english: give us not as a prey to death, to be destroyed by thee in wrath, To thy fierce anger when displeased.

sanskrit: vi mr̥l̥īkāya te manaḥ rathīḥ aśvam na sam ditam gīrbhiḥ varuṇa sīmahi
english: To gain thy mercy, Varuṇa, with hymns we bind thy heart, as binds The charioteer his tethered horse.

sanskrit: parā hi me vi manyavaḥ patanti vasyaḥ iṣṭaye vayaḥ na vasatīḥ upa
english: They flee from me dispirited, bent only on obtaining wealths As to their nests the birds of air.

sanskrit: kadā kṣatra śriyam naram ā varuṇam karāmahe mr̥l̥īkāya uru cakṣasam
english: When shall we bring, to be appeased, the Hero, Lord of warrior might, Him, the far-seeing Varuṇa?

sanskrit: tat it samānam āśāteiti venantā na pra yucchataḥ dhr̥ta vratāya dāśuṣe
english: This, this with joy they both accept in common: never do they fail The ever-faithful worshipper.

sanskrit: veda yaḥ vīnām padam antarikṣeṇa patatām veda nāvaḥ samudriyaḥ
english: He knows the path of birds that fly through heaven, and, Sovran of the sea, He knows the ships that are thereon.

sanskrit: veda māsaḥ dhr̥ta vrataḥ dvādaśa prajāvataḥ veda yaḥ upa jāyate
english: True to his holy law, he knows the twelve moons with their progeny: He knows the moon of later birth.

sanskrit: veda vātasya vartanim uroḥ r̥ṣvasya br̥hataḥ veda ye adhi āsate
english: He knows the pathway of the wind, the spreading, high, and mighty wind He knows the Gods who dwell above.

sanskrit: ni sasāda dhr̥ta vrataḥ varuṇaḥ pastyāsu ā sām rājyāya su kratuḥ
english: Varuṇa, true to holy law, sits down among his people; he, Most wise, sits there to govern all.

sanskrit: ataḥ viśvāni adbhutā cikitvān abhi paśyati kr̥tāni yā ca kartvā
english: From thence percerving he beholds all wondrous things, both what hath been, And what hereafter will be done.

sanskrit: saḥ naḥ viśvāhā su kratuḥ ādityaḥ su pathā karat pra naḥ āyūṁṣi tāriṣat
english: May that Âditya, very -wise, make fair paths for us all our days: May lie prolong our lives for us.

sanskrit: bibhrat drāpim hiraṇyayam varuṇaḥ vasta niḥ nijam pari spaśaḥ ni sedire
english: Varuṇa, wearing golden mail, hath clad him in a shining robe. His spies are seated found about.

sanskrit: na yam dipsanti dipsavaḥ na druhvāṇaḥ janānām na devam abhi mātayaḥ
english: The God whom enemies threaten not, nor those who tyrannize o'er men, Nor those whose minds are bent on wrong.

sanskrit: uta yaḥ mānuṣeṣu ā yaśaḥ cakre asāmi ā asmākam udareṣu ā
english: He who gives glory to mankind, not glory that is incomplete, To our own bodies giving it.

sanskrit: parāḥ me yanti dhītayaḥ gāvaḥ na gavyūtīḥ anu icchantīḥ uru cakṣasam
english: Yearning for the wide-seeing One, my thoughts move onward unto him, As kine unto their pastures move.

sanskrit: sam nu vocāvahai punaḥ yataḥ me madhu ābhr̥tam hotāiva kṣadase priyam
english: Once more together let us speak, because my meath is brought: priest-like Thou eatest what is dear to thee.

sanskrit: darśam nu viśva darśatam darśam ratham adhi kṣami etāḥ juṣata me giraḥ
english: Now saw I him whom all may see, I saw his car above the earth: He hath accepted these my songs.

sanskrit: imam me varuṇa śrudhi havam adya ca mr̥l̥aya tvām avasyuḥ ā cakre
english: Varuṇa, hear this call of mine: be gracious unto us this day Longing for help I cried to thee.

sanskrit: tvam viśvasya medhira divaḥ ca gmaḥ ca rājasi saḥ yāmani prati śrudhi
english: Thou, O wise God, art Lord of all, thou art the King of earth and heaven Hear, as thou goest on thy way.

sanskrit: ut ut tamam mumugdhi naḥ vi pāśam madhyamañ cr̥ta ava adhamāni jīvase
english: Release us from the upper bond, untie the bond between, and loose The bonds below, that I may live.

sanskrit: vasiṣva hi miyedhya vastrāṇi ūrjām pate saḥ imam naḥ adhvaram yaja
english: O WORTHY of oblation, Lord of prospering powers, assume thy robes, And offer this our sacrifice.

sanskrit: ni naḥ hotā vareṇyaḥ sadā yaviṣṭha manma bhiḥ agne divitmatā vacaḥ
english: Sit ever to be chosen, as our Priest., most youthful, through our hymns, O Agni, through our heavenly word.

sanskrit: ā hi sma sūnave pitā āpiḥ yajati āpaye sakhā sakhye vareṇyaḥ
english: For here a Father for his son, Kinsman for kinsman worshippeth, And Friend, choice-worthy, for his friend.

sanskrit: ā naḥ barhiḥ riśādasaḥ varuṇaḥ mitraḥ aryamā sīdantu manuṣaḥ yathā
english: Fiere let the foe-destroyers sit, Varuṇa, Mitra, Aryaman, Like men, upon our sacred grass.

sanskrit: pūrvya hotaḥ asya naḥ mandasva sakhyasya ca imāḥ oṁ iti su śrudhī giraḥ
english: O ancient Herald, be thou glad in this our rite and fellowship: Hearken thou well to these our songs.

sanskrit: yat cit hi śaśvatā tanā devam devam yajāmahe tve iti it hūyate haviḥ
english: Whate'er in this perpetual course we sacrifice to God and God, That gift is offered up in thee

sanskrit: priyaḥ naḥ astu viśpatiḥ hotām mandraḥ vareṇyaḥ priyāḥ su agnayaḥ vayam
english: May he be our dear household Lord, Priest, pleasant and, choice-worthy may We, with bright fires, be dear to him.

sanskrit: su agnayaḥ hi vāryam devāsaḥ dadhire ca naḥ su agnayaḥ manāmahe
english: The Gods, adored with brilliant fires. have granted precious wealth to us So, with bright fires, we pray to thee.

sanskrit: atha naḥ ubhayeṣām amr̥ta martyānām mithaḥ santu pra śastayaḥ
english: And, O Immortal One, so may the eulogies of mortal men Belong to us and thee alike.

sanskrit: viśvebhiḥ agne agni bhiḥ imam yajñam idam vacaḥ canaḥ dhāḥ sahasa yaho iti
english: With all thy fires, O Agni, find pleasure in this our sacrifice, And this our speech, O Son of Strength.

sanskrit: aśvam na tvā vāra vantam vandadhyai agnim namobhiḥ sam rājantam adhvarāṇām
english: WITH worship will I glorify thee, Agni, like a long-tailed steed, Imperial Lord of sacred rites.

sanskrit: saḥ gha naḥ sūnuḥ śavasā pr̥thu pragāmā su śevaḥ mīḍhavān asmākam babhūyāt
english: May the far-striding Son of Strength, bringer of great felicity, Who pours his gifts like rain, be ours.

sanskrit: saḥ naḥ dūrāt ca āsāt ca ni martyāt agha yoḥ pāhi sadam it viśva āyuḥ
english: Lord of all life, from near; from far, do thou, O Agni evermore Protect us from the sinful man.

sanskrit: imam oṁ iti su tvam asmākam sanim gāyatram navyāṁsam agne deveṣu pra vocaḥ
english: O Agni, graciously announce this our oblation to the Gods, And this our newest song of praise.

sanskrit: ā naḥ bhaja parameṣu ā vājeṣu madhyameṣu śikṣā vasvaḥ antamasya
english: Give us a share of strength most high, a share of strength that is below, A share of strength that is between.

sanskrit: vi bhaktā asi citrabhāno iticitra bhāno sindhoḥ ūrmau upāke ā sadyaḥ dāśuṣe kṣarasi
english: Thou dealest gifts, resplendent One; nigh, as with waves of Sindhu, thou Swift streamest to the worshipper.

sanskrit: yam agne pr̥t su martyam avāḥ vājeṣu yam junāḥ saḥ yantā śaśvatīḥ iṣaḥ
english: That man is lord of endless strength whom thou protectest in the fight, Agni, or urgest to the fray.

sanskrit: nakiḥ asya sahantya pari etā kayasya cit vājaḥ asti śravāyyaḥ
english: Him, whosoever he may be, no man may vanquish, mighty One: Nay, very glorious power is his.

sanskrit: saḥ vājam viśva carṣaṇiḥ arvat bhiḥ astu tarutā viprebhiḥ astu sanitā
english: May he who dwells with all mankind bear us with war-steeds through the fight, And with the singers win the spoil.

sanskrit: jarābodha tat viviḍḍhi viśe viśe yajñiyāya stomam rudrāya dr̥śīkam
english: Help, thou who knowest lauds, this work, this eulogy to Rudra, him Adorable in every house.

sanskrit: saḥ naḥ mahān ani mānaḥ dhūma ketuḥ puru candraḥ dhiye vājāya hinvatu
english: May this our God, great, limitless, smoke-bannered excellently bright, Urge us to strength and holy thought.

sanskrit: saḥ revān iva viśpatiḥ daivyaḥ ketuḥ śr̥ṇotu naḥ ukthaiḥ agniḥ br̥hat bhānuḥ
english: Like some rich Lord of men may he, Agni the banner of the Gods, Refulgent, hear us through our lauds.

sanskrit: namaḥ mahat bhyaḥ namaḥ arbhakebhyaḥ namaḥ yuvabhyaḥ namaḥ āśinebhyaḥ yajāma devān yadi śaknavāma mā jyāyasaḥ śaṁsam ā vr̥kṣi devāḥ
english: Glory to Gods, the mighty and the lesser glory to Gods the younger and the elder! Let us, if we have power, pay the God worship: no better prayer than this, ye Gods, acknowledge.

sanskrit: yatra grāvā pr̥thu budhnaḥ ūrdhvaḥ bhavati sotave ulūkhala sutānām ava it oṁ iti indra jalgulaḥ
english: THERE where the broad-based stone raised on high to press the juices out, O Indra, drink with eager thirst the droppings which the mortar sheds.

sanskrit: yatra dvau iva jaghanā adhi savanyā kr̥tā ulūkhala sutānām ava it oṁ iti indra jalgulaḥ
english: Where, like broad hips, to hold the juice the platters of the press are laid, O Indra, drink with eager thirst the droppings which the mortar sheds.

sanskrit: yatra nārī apa cyavam upa cyavam ca śikṣate ulūkhala sutānām ava it oṁ iti indra jalgulaḥ
english: There where the woman marks and leans the pestle's constant rise and fall, O Indra, drink with eager thirst the droppings which the mortar sheds.

sanskrit: yatra manthām vi badhnate raśmīn yamitavai iva ulūkhala sutānām ava it oṁ iti indra jalgulaḥ
english: Where, as with reins to guide a horse, they bind the churning-staff with cords, O Indra, drink with eager thirst the droppings which the mortar sheds.

sanskrit: yat cit hi tvam gr̥he gr̥he ulūkhalaka yujyase iha dyumat tamam vada jayatām iva dundubhiḥ
english: If of a truth in every house, O Mortar thou art set for work, Here give thou forth thy clearest sound, loud as the drum of conquerors.

sanskrit: uta sma te vanaspate vātaḥ vi vāti agram it atho iti indrāya pātave sunu somam ulūkhala
english: O Sovran of the Forest, as the wind blows soft in front of thee, Mortar, for Indra press thou forth the Soma juice that he may drink.

sanskrit: āyajī ity āyajī vāja sātamā tā hi uccā vi jarbhr̥taḥ harīivetiharī iva andhāṁsi bapsatā
english: Best strength-givers, ye stretch wide jaws, O Sacrificial Implements, Like two bay horses champing herbs.

sanskrit: tā naḥ adya vanaspatī iti r̥ṣvau r̥ṣvebhiḥ sotr̥ bhiḥ indrāya madhu mat sutam
english: Ye Sovrans of the Forest, both swift, with swift pressers press to-day Sweet Soma juice for Indra's drink.

sanskrit: ut śiṣṭam camvoḥ bhara somam pavitre ā sr̥ja ni dhehi goḥ adhi tvaci
english: Take up in beakers what remains: the Soma on the filter pour, and on the ox-hide set the dregs.

sanskrit: yat cit hi satya soma pā anāśastāḥ iva smasi ā tu naḥ indra śaṁsaya goṣu aśveṣu śubhriṣu sahasreṣu tuvī magha
english: O SOMA DRINKER, ever true, utterly hopeless though we be, Do thou, O Indra, give us hope of beauteous horses and of kine, In thousands, O most wealthy One.

sanskrit: śiprin vājānām pate śacī vaḥ tava daṁsanā ā tu naḥ indra śaṁsaya goṣu aśveṣu śubhriṣu sahasreṣu tuvī magha
english: O Lord of Strength, whose jaws are strong, great deeds are thine, the powerful: Do thou, O Indra, give us hope of beauteous horses and of kine, In thousands, O most wealthy One.

sanskrit: ni svāpaya mithu dr̥śā sastām abudhyamāneiti ā tu naḥ indra śaṁsaya goṣu aśveṣu śubhriṣu sahasreṣu tuvī magha
english: Lull thou asleep, to wake no more, the pair who on each other look Do thou, O Indra, give us, help of beauteous horses and of kine, In thousands, O most wealthy One.

sanskrit: sasantu tyāḥ arātayaḥ bodhantu śūra rātayaḥ ā tu naḥ indra śaṁsaya goṣu aśveṣu śubhriṣu sahasreṣu tuvī magha
english: Hero, let hostile spirits sleep, and every gentler genius wake: Do thou, O Indra,. give us hope of beauteous horses and of kine, In thousands, O most wealthy One.

sanskrit: sam indra gardabham mr̥ṇa nuvantam pāpayā amuyā ā tu naḥ indra śaṁsaya goṣu aśveṣu śubhriṣu sahasreṣu tuvī magha
english: Destroy this ass, O Indra, who in tones discordant brays to thee: Do thou, O Indra, give us hope of beauteous horses and of kine, In thousands, O most wealthy One.

sanskrit: patāti kuṇḍr̥ṇācyā dūram vātaḥ vanāt adhi ā tu naḥ indra śaṁsaya goṣu aśveṣu śubhriṣu sahasreṣu tuvī magha
english: Far distant on the forest fall the tempest in a circling course! Do thou, O Indra, give us hope of beauteous horses and of kine, In thousands, O most wealthy One.

sanskrit: sarvam pari krośam jahi jambhaya kr̥kadāśvam ā tu naḥ indra śaṁsaya goṣu aśveṣu śubhriṣu sahasreṣu tuvī magha
english: Slay each reviler, and destroy him who in secret injures us: Do thou, O Indra, give us hope of beauteous horses and of kine In thousands, O most wealthy One.

sanskrit: ā vaḥ indram krivim yathā vāja yantaḥ śata kratum maṁhiṣṭhaṁsiñce indu bhiḥ
english: WE seeking strength with Soma-drops fill full your Indra like a well, Most liberal, Lord of Hundred Powers,

sanskrit: śatam vā yaḥ śucīnām sahasram vā sam āśirām ā it oṁ iti nimnam na rīyate
english: Who lets a hundred of the pure, a thousand of the milk-blent draughts Flow, even as down a depth, to him;

sanskrit: sam yat madāya śuṣmiṇe enā hi asya udare samudraḥ na vyacaḥ dadhe
english: When for the strong, the rapturous joy he in this manner hath made room Within his belly, like the sea.

sanskrit: ayam oṁ iti te sam atasi kapotaḥ iva garbha dhim vacaḥ tat cit naḥ ohase
english: This is thine own. Thou drawest near, as turns a pigeon to his mate: Thou carest too for this our prayer.

sanskrit: stotram rādhānām pate girvāhaḥ vīra yasya te vi bhūtiḥ astu sunr̥tā
english: O Hero, Lord of Bounties, praised in hymns, may power and joyfulness Be his who sings the laud to thee.

sanskrit: ūrdhvaḥ tiṣṭha naḥ ūtaye asmin vāje śatakrato itiśata krato sam anyeṣu bravāvahai
english: Lord of a Hundred Powers, stand up to lend us succour in this fight In others too let us agree.

sanskrit: yoge yoge tavaḥ taram vāje vāje havāmahe sakhāyaḥ indram ūtaye
english: In every need, in every fray we call as friends to succour us Indra the mightiest of all.

sanskrit: ā gha gamat yadi śravat sahasriṇībhiḥ ūti bhiḥ vājebhiḥ upa naḥ havam
english: If he will hear us let him come with succour of a thousand kinds, And all that strengthens, to our call.

sanskrit: anu pratnasya okasaḥ huve tuvi pratim naram yam te pūrvam pitā huve
english: I call him mighty to resist, the Hero of our ancient home, Thee whom my sire invoked of old.

sanskrit: tam tvā vayam viśva vāra ā śāsmahe puru hūta sakhe vaso iti jaritr̥ bhyaḥ
english: We pray to thee, O much-invoked, rich in all prccious gifts, O Friend, Kind God to those who sing thy praise.

sanskrit: asmākam śipriṇīnām soma pāḥ soma pāvnām sakhe vajrin sakhīnām
english: O Soma-drinker, Thunder-armed, Friend of our lovely-featured dames And of our Soma-drinking friends.

sanskrit: tathā tat astu soma pāḥ sakhe vajrin tathā kr̥ṇu yathā te uśmasi iṣṭaye
english: Thus, Soma-drinker, may it be; thus, Friend, who wieldest thunder, act To aid each wish as we desire.

sanskrit: revatīḥ naḥ sadha māde indre santu tuvi vājāḥ kṣu mantaḥ yābhiḥ madema
english: With Indra splendid feasts be ours, rich in all strengthening things wherewith, Wealthy in food, we may rejoice.

sanskrit: ā gha tvāvān tmanā āptaḥ stotr̥ bhyaḥ dhr̥ṣṇo iti iyānaḥ r̥ṇoḥ akṣam na cakryoḥ
english: Like thee, thyself, the singers' Friend, thou movest, as it were, besought, Bold One, the axle of the car.

sanskrit: ā yat duvaḥ śatakrato itiśata krato ā kāmam jaritr̥r̥ṇām r̥ṇoḥ akṣam na śacībhiḥ
english: That, Ṣatakratu, thou to grace and please thy praisers, as it were, Stirrest the axle with thy strength.

sanskrit: śaśvat indraḥ popruthat bhiḥ jagāya nānadat bhiḥ śāśvasat bhiḥ dhanāni saḥ naḥ hiraṇya ratham daṁsanāvān saḥ naḥ sanitā sanaye saḥ naḥ adāt
english: With champing, neighing loudly-snorting horses Indra hath ever won himself great treasures A car of gold hath he whose deeds are wondrous received from us, and let us too receive it.

sanskrit: ā aśvinau aśva vatyā iṣā yātam śavīrayā go mat dasrā hiraṇya vat
english: Come, Aṣvins, with enduring strength wealthy in horses and in kine, And gold, O ye of wondrous deeds.

sanskrit: samāna yojanaḥ hi vām rathaḥ dasrau amartyaḥ samudre aśvinā īyate
english: Your chariot yoked for both alike, immortal, ye of mighty acts, Travels, O Aivins, in the sea.

sanskrit: ni aghnyasya mūrdhani cakram rathasya yemathuḥ pari dyām anyat īyate
english: High on the forehead of the Bull one chariot wheel ye ever keep, The other round the sky revolves.

sanskrit: kaḥ te uṣaḥ kadha priye bhuje martaḥ amartye kam nakṣase vibhā vari
english: What mortal, O immortal Dawn, enjoyeth thee? Where lovest thou? To whom, O radiant, dost thou go?

sanskrit: vayam hi te amanmahi ā antāt ā parākāt aśve na citre aruṣi
english: For we have had thee in our thoughts whether anear or far away, Red-hued and like a dappled mare.

sanskrit: tvam tyebhiḥ ā gahi vājebhiḥ duhitaḥ divaḥ asme iti rayim ni dhāraya
english: Hither, O Daughter of the Sky, come thou with these thy strengthenings, And send thou riches down to us.

sanskrit: tvam agne prathamāḥ aṅgirā r̥ṣiḥ devaḥ devānām abhavaḥ śivaḥ sakhā tava vrate kavayaḥ vidmanāapasaḥ ajāyanta marutaḥ bhrājat r̥ṣṭayaḥ
english: Thou, Agni, wast the earliest Angiras, a Seer; thou wast, a God thyself, the Gods' auspicious Friend. After thy holy ordinance the Maruts, sage, active through wisdom, -with their glittering spears, were born.

sanskrit: tvam agne prathamaḥ aṅgiraḥ tamaḥ kaviḥ devānām pari bhūṣasi vratam vi bhuḥ viśvasmai bhuvanāya medhiraḥ dvi mātā śayuḥ katidhā cit āyave
english: O Agni, thou, the best and earliest Angiras, fulfillest as a Sage the holy law of Gods. Sprung from two mothers, wise, through all existence spread, resting in many a place for sake of living man.

sanskrit: tvam agne prathamaḥ mātariśvane āviḥ bhava sukratū yā vivasvate arejetām rodasī iti hotr̥ vūrye asaghnoḥ bhāram ayajaḥ mahaḥ vaso iti
english: To Mâtariṣvan first thou, Agni, wast disclosed, and to Vivasvan through thy noble inward power. Heaven and Earth, Vasu! shook at the choosing of the Priest: the burthen thou didst bear, didst worship mighty Gods.

sanskrit: tvam agne manave dyām avāśayaḥ purūravase su kr̥te sukr̥t taraḥ śvātreṇa yat pitroḥ mucyase pari ā tvā pūrvam anayan ā aparam punariti
english: Agni thou madest heaven to thunder for mankind; thou, yet more pious, for pious Purûravâs. When thou art rapidly freed from thy parents, first eastward they bear thee round, and, after, to the west.

sanskrit: tvam agne vr̥ṣabhaḥ puṣṭi vardhanaḥ udyata sruce bhavasi śravāyyaḥ yaḥ āhutim pari veda vaṣaṭ kr̥tim eka āyuḥ agne viśaḥ āvivāsasi
english: Thou, Agni, art a Bull who makes our store increase, to be invoked by him who lifts the ladle up. Well knowing the oblation with the hallowing word, uniting all who live, thou lightenest first our folk

sanskrit: tvam agne vr̥jina vartanim naram sakman piparṣi vidathe vi carṣaṇe yaḥ śūra sātā pari takmye dhane dabhrebhiḥ cit sam r̥tā haṁsi bhūyasaḥ
english: Agni, thou savest in the synod when pursued e'en him, farseeing One! who walks in evil ways. Thou, when the heroes fight for spoil which men rush, round, slayest in war the many by the hands of few.

sanskrit: tvam tam agne amr̥ta tve ut tame martam dadhāsi śravase dive dive yaḥ tatr̥ṣāṇaḥ ubhayāya janmane mayaḥ kr̥ṇoṣi prayaḥ ā ca sūraye
english: For glory, Agni, day by day, thou liftest up the mortal man to highest immortality, Even thou who yearning for both races givest them great bliss, and to the prince grantest abundant food.

sanskrit: tvam naḥ agne sanaye dhanānām yaśasam kārum kr̥ṇuhi stavānaḥ r̥dhyāma karma apasā navena devaiḥ dyāvāpr̥thivī iti pra avatam naḥ
english: O Agni, highly lauded, make our singer famous that he may win us store of riches: May we improve the rite with new performance. O Earth and Heaven, with all the Gods, protect us.

sanskrit: tvam naḥ agne pitroḥ upa sthe ā devaḥ deveṣu anavadya jāgr̥viḥ tanū kr̥t bodhi pra matiḥ ca kārave tvam kalyāṇa vasu viśvam ā ūpiṣe
english: O blameless Agni lying in thy Parents' lap, a God among the Gods, be watchful for our good. Former of bodies, be the singer's Providence: all good things hast thou sown for him, auspicious One!

sanskrit: tvam agne pra matiḥ tvam pitā asi naḥ tvam vayaḥ kr̥t tavajāmayaḥ vayam sam tvā rāyaḥ śatinaḥ sam sahasriṇaḥ suvīram yanti vrata pām adābhya
english: Agni, thou art our Providence, our Father thou – we are thy brethren and thou art our spring of life. in thee, rich in good heroes, guard of high decrees, meet hundred, thousand treasures, O infallible!

sanskrit: tvām agne prathamam āyum āyave devāḥ akr̥ṇvan nahuṣasya viśpatim il̥ām akr̥ṇvan manuṣasya śāsanīm pituḥ yat putraḥ mamakasya jāyate
english: Thee, Agni, have the Gods made the first living One for living man, Lord of the house of Nahusha. Iḷâ they made the teacher of the sons of men, what time a Son was born to the father of my race.

sanskrit: tvam naḥ agne tava deva pāyu bhiḥ maghonaḥ rakṣa tanvaḥ ca vandya trātā tokasya tanaye gavām asi ani meṣam rakṣamāṇaḥ tava vrate
english: Worthy to be revered, O Agni, God, preserve our wealthy patrons with thy succours, and ourselves. Guard of our seed art thou, aiding our cows to bear, incessantly protecting in thy holy way.

sanskrit: tvam agne yajyave pāyuḥ antaraḥ aniṣaṅgāya catuḥ akṣaḥ idhyase yaḥ rāta havyaḥ avr̥kāya dhāyase kīreḥ cit mantram manasā vanoṣi tam
english: Agni, thou art a guard close to the pious man; kindled art thou, four-eyed! for him who is unarmcd. With fond heart thou acceptest e'en the poor man's prayer, when he hath brought his gift to gain security.

sanskrit: tvam agne uru śaṁsāya vāghate spārham yat rekṇaḥ paramam vanoṣi tat ādhrasya cit pra matiḥ ucyase pitā pra pākam śāssi pra diśaḥ viduḥ ṭaraḥ
english: Thou, Agni gainest for the loudly-praising priest the highest wealth, the object of a man's desire. Thou art called Father, caring even for the weak, and wisest, to the simple one thou teachest lore.

sanskrit: tvam agne prayata dakṣiṇam naram varma iva syūtam pari pāsi viśvataḥ svādu kṣadmā yaḥ vasatau syona kr̥t jīva yājam yajate saḥ upa mā divaḥ
english: Agni, the man who giveth guerdon to the priests, like well-sewn armour thou guardest on every side. He who with grateful food shows kindness in his house, an offerer to the living, is the type of heaven.

sanskrit: imām agne śaraṇim mīmr̥ṣaḥ naḥ imam adhvānam yam agāma dūrāt āpiḥ pitā pra matiḥ somyānām bhr̥miḥ asi r̥ṣi kr̥t martyānām
english: Pardon, we pray, this sin of ours, O Agni, -- the path which we have trodden, widely straying, Dear Friend and Father, caring for the pious, who speedest nigh and who inspirest mortals.

sanskrit: manuṣvat agne aṅgirasvat aṅgiraḥ yayāti vat sadane pūrva vat śuce accha yāhi ā vaha daivyam janam ā sādaya barhiṣi yakṣi ca priyam
english: As erst to Manus, to Yayâti, Angiras, so Angiras! pure Agni! come thou to our hall Bring hither the celestial host and seat them here upon the sacred grass, and offer what they love.

sanskrit: etena agne brahmaṇā vavr̥dhasva śaktī vā yat te cakr̥ma vidā vā uta pra neṣi abhi vasyaḥ asmān sam naḥ sr̥ja su matyā vāja vatyā
english: By this our prayer be thou, O Agni, strengthened, prayer made by us after our power and knowledge. Lead thou us, therefore, to increasing riches; endow us with thy strength-bestowing favour.

sanskrit: indrasya nu vīryāṇi pra vocam yāni cakāra prathamāni vajrī ahan ahim anu apaḥ tatarda pra vakṣaṇāāḥ abhinat parvatānām
english: I WILL declare the manly deeds of Indra, the first that he achieved, the Thunder-wielder. He slew the Dragon, then disclosed the waters, and cleft the channels of the mountain torrents.

sanskrit: ahan ahim parvate śiśriyāṇam tvaṣṭā asmai vajram svaryam tatakṣa vāśrāḥ iva dhenavaḥ syandamānāḥ añjaḥ samudram ava jagmuḥ āpaḥ
english: He slew the Dragon lying on the mountain: his heavenly bolt of thunder Tvashṭar fashioned. Like lowing kine in rapid flow descending the waters glided downward to the ocean.

sanskrit: vr̥ṣa yamāṇaḥ avr̥ṇīta somam tri kadrukeṣu apibat sutasya ā sāyakam maghavā adatta vajram ahan enam prathama jām ahīnām
english: Impetuous as a bull, he chose the Soma and in three sacred beakers drank the juices. Maghavan grasped the thunder for his weapon, and smote to death this firstborn of the dragons.

sanskrit: yat indra ahan prathama jām ahīnām āt māyinām amināḥ pra uta māyāḥ āt sūryam janayan dyām uṣāsam tādītnā śatrum na kilā vivitse
english: When, Indra, thou hadst slain the dragon's firstborn, and overcome the charms of the enchanters, Then, giving life to Sun and Dawn and Heaven, thou foundest not one foe to stand against thee.
